catalog_summary.json.description: Earthquake catalog metadata and summary statistics

total_events.description: Total number of earthquakes in the catalog

time_span_days.description: Time span of the catalog in days

time_span_years.description: Time span of the catalog in years

region.description: Geographic bounds of the query region

grid_bvalues.json.description: Gutenberg-Richter frequency-magnitude analysis per spatial grid cell

cells.description: Array of grid cells meeting the minimum event threshold

event_count.description: Total number of events in the cell

site_design.json.description: ASCE 7-22 seismic design parameters per building site

sites.description: Array of 5 building sites with design parameters

sds.description: Design spectral acceleration at short periods (g)

ss.description: MCEr spectral acceleration at short periods (g)

sms.description: Site-modified spectral acceleration at short periods (g)

sdc.description: Seismic Design Category (one of A, B, C, D, E, F)

site_activity.json.description: Observed seismicity metrics within search radius of each building site

catalog_time_span_years.description: Catalog time span in years used for annualization

sites.description: Array of 5 building sites with activity metrics

events_within_radius.description: Number of catalog events within search radius

max_magnitude.description: Maximum magnitude among events within radius (null if none)

nearest_event_distance_km.description: Distance to nearest event in km (null if none)

annualized_rate_all.description: Annualized rate of all events within radius

events_m4plus.description: Number of M4.0+ events within radius

discrepancy.json.description: Hazard consistency assessment comparing observed seismicity to design parameters

sites.description: Array of 5 building sites with discrepancy analysis

sds.description: SDS value from design parameters (null if unavailable)

annualized_rate.description: Annualized event rate within search radius

max_observed_magnitude.description: Maximum observed magnitude within radius (null if none)

discrepancy_ratio.description: Computed as (annualized_rate * max_observed_magnitude / 10) / SDS; null if inputs missing

classification.description: One of: observed_exceeds_design, design_exceeds_observed, consistent, insufficient_data
